pack.description: A Speed Racer HD Texture Replacement Pack for PCSX2

tool.description: Tool to rip models from PS2/WII Speed Racer

not_found: A verified, ready-to-use PS2 Speed Racer skin pack repository compatible with this native port was not located in the searches; this is not proof none exists.

forecast.kind: conditional planning estimate, not a commitment or statistical forecast
forecast.start_condition: Legitimate local disc restored, sustained engineering/QA work resumed; distribution/provenance gates must also pass.

alpha_for_small_friend_test.scope: Limited experimental Windows alpha on explicitly tested configurations; known performance limits disclosed; no stable60FPS or full-game certification.

broader_stable_vanilla.scope: Full-race/long-session speed, pacing, original graphics, saves/audio/input and portable package acceptance.

forecast.reestimate_after: Reproduce/isolate Skorost regression and complete one reproducible full-race plus portable-data boot test.

aliasing.strong_code_based_explanation: Default1x source around640x479 enlarged to the window, no modern edge-AA pass in current blit; inference, not a confirmed diagnosis of the current user frame.
aliasing.existing_v2_scale_execution: Historical1x/2x/3x execution exists; not fresh v13 validation or performance certification.

required: Identify/hash original texture+palette/region without framebuffer confusion
Decode external image/mips and keep bounded CPU/GPU cache
Respect GS feedback, CLUT, alpha/depth hazards
Keep optional reversible packs and Vanilla fallback; benchmark IO/memory/pacing
native_integration.skins: Cosmetic texture-only liveries may fit future replacement support. New geometry/model skins need a separate asset-format pipeline; no ready native-compatible PS2 skin repository verified.

next_graphics_protocol.separate_images: Matched state/input/camera at1x/2x; inspect silhouettes, road edges, HUD, alpha, mip and framebuffer effects; sync captures are not FPS benchmarks.
next_graphics_protocol.acceptance: No lost effects or new artifacts; no preset promotion without measured speed/pacing and correctness.
